components.name: Primary Button

narrative.overview: The catalogue is the composition. UniqueLo sells hand-embroidered garments between ₹899 and ₹1,899 to buyers who arrive from Instagram on a mid-range Android in daylight, so the storefront is built like a woven index rather than a campaign: unbleached cotton ground, a dense grid of garments each carrying its real price, hairline rules doing all the separating, and one dyed-indigo band allowed to interrupt the page for the craft story. Nothing rests on a shadow; nothing floats in a card. The palette is cloth, not luxury — cotton ground, dyed-indigo foreground rather than black, and exactly one saturated colour, madder red, which marks action and price and never decoration. Typography is the label on the garment: Archivo's width axis does the shouting, Geist carries reading text, and Geist Mono is reserved for prices so digits line up down a grid.
keyCharacteristics: Unbleached cotton canvas (#f4efe4), paper surfaces (#fbf8f1), dyed-indigo ink (#141a2e) — never pure black or pure white.
One saturated colour: madder red, for primary actions, price emphasis, and nothing else.
Condensed Archivo display at 78% width; Geist for reading; Geist Mono for every price and count.
Square corners everywhere except controls (4px) and the bag (14px).
Hairline loom rules carry the entire layout; resting shadows do not exist.
Photography sits directly on paper with no frame, scrim, or overlay.

rules.name: The One Saturated Colour Rule
rules.body: Madder is the only saturated colour in the base system. If a surface needs a second hue, it is a universe block — and then the hue comes from that universe's accent.

rules.name: The Colour Is Never The Only Signal Rule
rules.body: Every universe band, sale state, and stock state prints its name in words beside the colour.

rules.name: The Dyed-Not-Black Rule
rules.body: Foreground is #141a2e, never #000; canvas is #f4efe4, never #fff.

rules.name: The Two-Width Rule
rules.body: Display type gets its power from Archivo's width axis, not from a second family. 78% for headings, 62% for labels.

rules.name: The Serif Is Retired Rule
rules.body: Playfair and every serif voice are gone as a design decision; no new surface may name a serif.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Money Rule
rules.body: Prices, counts, and figures are Geist Mono with tabular-nums. Body copy and headings are never mono.

rules.name: The No Resting Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface at rest is flat and delineated by a hairline or a tonal step. If a component needs a shadow to read as a component, the component is wrong.

rules.name: The One Dark Band Rule
rules.body: Exactly one section per page inverts to bg-ink. Inversion is attention, and attention is not free.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: Corners are 0 everywhere except controls (4px) and the bag (14px).

rules.name: The No-Scrim Rule
rules.body: Text never sits on a photograph behind a gradient. Captions sit beneath the image on paper at the label size.

dos: Do set every price and count in loom-price (Geist Mono, tabular) so figures align in a column.
Do separate sections with 1px border-stone and a py-12 lg:py-16 rhythm rather than with cards, shadows, or background changes.
Do keep the dark theme a structural equal: same components, same rules, [data-mode='dark'] values only.
Do state a claim only when a catalogue field or the pricing function backs it; otherwise omit it.
Do carry aria-pressed on toggles, aria-label on icon buttons, and 44px minimum on every target.
Do let one section per page invert to ink, and let that be the craft story.
donts: Don't reintroduce a serif display voice, gold/zari accents, terracotta, or 16–20px portal cards.
Don't put text on a photograph behind a scrim, and don't crop a garment to a fixed portrait frame.
Don't fabricate scarcity, ratings, review counts, artisan names, shipping thresholds, or return windows.
Don't add resting shadows, rounded product cards, or hover lift-and-scale.
Don't add a marquee, a scrolling announcement ticker, or any continuously animating chrome.
Don't use pure black, pure white, or a second saturated hue outside a universe block.
